scope: P8 Windows startup, minimized launch, close-to-tray and hardware acceleration preferences.
implemented: Electron persists a validated device-local settings document and reflects the live Windows login-item state in the renderer.
Start-minimized suppresses the initial window while retaining the tray entry; close-to-tray intercepts ordinary close while explicit quit bypasses it.
Hardware acceleration is applied before Electron ready on the next launch and the renderer states that restart is required.
Renderer writes roll back to the previous visible value and show an error when the desktop bridge rejects persistence. Web does not render the desktop-only destination.
remaining: Installed-Windows acceptance must still verify registry persistence through update, startup/tray reachability, explicit quit, and GPU feature state after restart.
release: Source and automated fixtures only; no commit, push, merge, deployment or Windows update was performed.
